axis_score_to_evidence.raw_cell_score: exact all-retained-pair mean(flower CIELAB distance - background CIELAB distance) for opposite-side pairs minus the corresponding mean for same-side pairs
axis_score_to_evidence.threshold_marginalization: arithmetic mean of all finite raw cell scores over the five frozen thresholds for each species and axis; an axis is unavailable if no threshold is evaluable
axis_score_to_evidence.species_standardization: subtract the equal-weight mean across the 96 finite axis scores and divide by their population RMS; if RMS<=1e-12, all axis evidence is zero
axis_score_to_evidence.axis_log_evidence: standardized axis score minus logmeanexp of standardized scores across the 96 fixed axes, so the equal-weight independent-axis baseline has mean likelihood ratio one
axis_score_to_evidence.training_posterior: reuse the frozen v1 mixture mapping over sharing fractions: product over training species of (1-f)+f*exp(axis_log_evidence), with a uniform prior over the six sharing fractions and 96 axes
axis_score_to_evidence.evaluation_predictive_ratio: posterior-weighted mixture of the independent baseline and exp(axis_log_evidence) for each held-out evaluation species
axis_score_to_evidence.normalization_note: no division by photo count because the standardized axis evidence is dimensionless

retention.selection: deterministic world-specific random priority within each frozen 300-photo species pool; first exact retained count unless the coordinate-dependent nuisance arm applies its frozen weighted-retention mechanism

world_census.calibration: 7 nuisance scenarios x 3 retention fractions x 250 replicates = 5250 worlds
world_census.evaluation_nuisance: 7 nuisance scenarios x 3 retention fractions x 250 replicates = 5250 worlds
world_census.evaluation_positive: 19 positive scenarios x 3 retention fractions x 250 replicates = 14250 worlds

synthetic_scale.geographic_nuisance_gradient_direction: world-specific random unit-sphere normal independent of any shared flower boundary except in the named matched-gradient nuisance

calibration.single_global_threshold: maximum of the 21 nuisance-arm calibration quantiles

claim_ceiling: Technical mapping and synthetic qualification only; no observed flower-colour evidence.
